_comment: F25 producer manifest for the scratch allocation sentry. Seeds the plan 1.3 T01-T17 temporary-path inventory. Slice 2 migrated T01-T08 and Slice 3 migrated T09-T17 onto the ScratchManager capability seam: every row's status is 'migrated', each carries an allocation wrapper and an acceptance witness, and the AST (per-producer drift guard) + syscall checks enforce them. A whole-module exclusion is never allowed; each row names its exact producer module(s). Call-site exemptions are explicit, with a rationale, in 'exemptions'. The sanctioned durable-output sinks the plan carves out (direct quarantine JSONL, model-pack output, rotating logs) are listed in 'durable_output_sinks'; they are classified durable writers, not scratch, and a new temporary sibling cannot inherit that classification.

producers.allocation: run_fk_out_of_core opens one attempt arena (ensure_scratch) and threads it into every T01-T08 producer via the execution context (the `arena` kwarg).
producers.note: default decoy-ooc-* stage root or caller temp_dir; the attempt arena is created beneath it and owns every data write.

producers.allocation: MaskedKeyStager takes a RegisteredFile; the staged masked_keys ParquetWriter opens unwrap_path(it).
_build_relation rebinds its work dir to unwrap_dir(arena.allocate_native_dir(...)); the relation output, staged/winners COPY scratch and DuckDB spill all live under it.
producers.note: per-parent key relation/staged/winners parquet + native dedup spill.

producers.allocation: merge_parent_relations rebinds its work dir to unwrap_dir(arena.allocate_native_dir(...)); the merged relation, staged/winners COPY scratch and DuckDB spill live under it.
producers.note: merged key relation/staged/winners + native merge/dedup spill.

producers.allocation: connect_duckdb resolves its temp directory through native_dir_path (a NativeDirectory capability); every helper caller allocates that directory from the attempt arena before connect.
producers.note: all helper-created DuckDB connections; managed opaque spill-directory handles.

producers.allocation: SpillPayloadStore / RawParentKeySpill / SpillChildKeys each take a RegisteredFile and open their Arrow IPC stream on unwrap_path(it); the drivers allocate those files from the attempt arena.
BoundedExternalSorter resolves its spill directory through native_dir_path (a NativeDirectory capability); every initial/merge run file lives under it.
producers.note: reorder runs, initial Arrow runs, merge-pass runs, final run.

producers.allocation: measure_pool_quality rebinds its work dir to native_dir_path(temp_dir); the cleartext pairs spool and DuckDB spill live under it.

ParquetTransactionalSink resolves its `_decoy_stage_*` staging directory through ensure_publication_stage (a destination-side PublicationStage when an attempt arena is injected); the whole-table write_table and the streamed ParquetWriter both write inside it, and the single commit rename is unchanged.

_Spill allocates its hold-back directory through ensure_native_dir (a registered NativeDirectory when an arena is injected, else the same `_decoy_hold_*`-beside-staging directory); the missing-capability failure (hold_back_spill_unavailable) and the schema hold-back replay are preserved.
producers.note: _decoy_hold_*/00000000.arrow; the naked spill-parent capability is replaced by manager allocation.

producers.allocation: _run_isolated allocates the work root through ensure_native_dir before _write_payload serializes sources/payload into it (register-before-write); the attempt capability is transported to the child over an inherited fd (_isolated_cap: pipe + CAP_FD_ENV names only the fd number, never argv/env/path for the capability), and the child writes only beneath the parent-registered root, so it never mints a fresh quota.
producers.note: decoy-isolated-run-*, sources/<name>.parquet, payload.json, result envelope; payload may carry credentials.

producers.allocation: sibling_staging_dir resolves the output stage through ensure_publication_stage (a registered destination-side PublicationStage when an arena is injected); the worker's _stage_outputs resolves its staging directory through native_dir_path. row_errors.json and the envelope ride the same staged commit-or-discard fate, owned after an abnormal child exit.
producers.note: sibling output stage or work_root/staging_output; row_errors.json, envelope.

producers.allocation: snapshot_tables_to_parquet allocates the DuckDB spill through ensure_native_dir and the Parquet stage through ensure_publication_stage (both registered when an arena is injected); the snapshot transaction, ordered COPY, deadline timer and extension pinning are unchanged, and the final snapshot-<run_id> is published by the same single rename.

run_subset stages the filtered Parquet and subset-manifest.json under a registered publication arena (ensure_publication_stage) and transfers ownership to output_dir with one atomic rename; materialize_subset resolves its write directory through native_dir_path. Closure-before-write and the non-empty-output guard are preserved. Without an arena the direct write to output_dir is unchanged.
producers.note: filtered <table>.parquet + subset-manifest.json; standalone publication stages then transfers ownership.

producers.allocation: finalize_committed_quarantine allocates a 0700 destination-side publication arena (ensure_publication_stage) and write_jsonl_staged writes the raw-quarantine `_decoy_quarantine_stage_*.jsonl` inside it through ensure_scratch_file; the stage charge is released once the sidecar's fate (os.link publish, or discard) is decided. Primary-error / cleanup behavior is unchanged. The DIRECT durable quarantine JSONL stays a classified durable sink (see durable_output_sinks), not a scratch exemption.
producers.note: _decoy_quarantine_stage_*.jsonl raw quarantine data in a destination-side arena.

producers.allocation: _write_all allocates the `.decoy-fw-*.tmp` staging file through ensure_publication_file (a registered destination-side stage file when an arena is injected, else the same owned temp in the target directory); the fsync, atomic os.replace and parent fsync are unchanged, and a write/fsync quota trip routes to the shared report.

run_discovery_sql configures the DuckDB connection's temp_directory from a registered native spill directory (ensure_native_dir) when an arena is injected; without one it disables spilling (temp_directory empty) so an over-budget query is rejected before any unprotected spill, never silently written to /tmp.
producers.note: in-memory DuckDB; native spill path registered/configured, or spilling disabled and the workload rejected.

exemptions.rationale: Stage-root container only (prefix decoy-ooc-*), created when the caller passes no temp_dir. It holds no data directly: the attempt arena is created beneath it (ensure_scratch) and owns every data write, and the local arena is released in the finally. Replaced by the lease local_stage_root when the qualified arena is injected at activation (Slice 6).

durable_output_sinks.rationale: The DIRECT durable quarantine JSONL (plan 1.3 quarantine.py:304) is a classified durable output sink, not scratch. T15 migrates only the staged raw-quarantine path; this direct sink writes the caller's chosen durable path. A new temporary sibling cannot inherit this classification.
Model-pack output (plan 1.3 trainer.py:539) is a durable artifact the caller asked for, not temporary scratch. Not a scratch producer; listed here so the carve-out is explicit.
Rotating operational logs (plan 1.3 internal/logging.py:101) are durable operational output, not scratch. Log hygiene (no data/expression text) is enforced separately; not a scratch producer.
